newsitem.title: USA: Motorola confirms loss of satellite contact.
newsitem.headline: Motorola confirms loss of satellite contact.

text.p: Motorola Inc said that the loss of communications with an IRIDIUM satellite on Thursday should not affect the scheduled date for commercial service in September 1998.
The satellite is one of five launched July 9, 1997 and was in a parking orbit awaiting its ascent to final mission orbit.

Motorola said it told Iridium that it had lost contact with the satellite, but said the anomaly should not affect the scheduled date for commercial service because it designed the IRIDIUM system to accommodate such an anomaly.
